description: This file contains support functions and hooks for the 'behave' BDD testing framework, focusing on active tags, environment setup, and test execution control.

classes.name: ActiveTagMatcher
classes.description: Class used to match and determine whether to skip features, scenarios, or rules based on active tags.

methods.name: require_tool
methods.description: Checks if a specified executable tool is available in the system's PATH.

methods.name: as_bool_string
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to 'yes' or 'no' string.

methods.name: discover_ci_server
methods.description: Detects the CI server environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: print_active_tags_summary
methods.description: Prints a summary of active tags such as Python version, implementation, and OS.

methods.name: before_all
methods.description: Hook executed before all tests; sets up command shell processors and prints active tags.

methods.name: before_feature
methods.description: Hook executed before each feature; skips feature if active tag matcher indicates so.

methods.name: before_rule
methods.description: Hook executed before each rule; skips rule if active tag matcher indicates so.

methods.name: before_scenario
methods.description: Hook executed before each scenario; skips scenario if active tag matcher indicates so.
